changelog:
AgentLink Skill 1.2.0 introduces cloud sandboxing for browser and Windows desktop automation via China Mobile AgentLink.

- Adds browser automation: navigation, screenshots, form interaction, and web scraping.
- Introduces Windows desktop control: run PowerShell/Python, manage files, and operate desktop apps.
- Skill now proactively handles any web, code execution, or desktop request—even without explicit sandbox/browser mention.
- Details configuration using the AGENTLINK_API_KEY environment variable.
- Documents usage patterns, core API methods, return types, and error handling for robust integration.
summary:
Cloud sandbox capabilities (Browser + Windows Desktop). Proactively use this skill when:
- User asks to open/visit any URL, view web content, or take web screenshots
- Need to extract data from websites, scrape information, or read page content
- Need to fill online forms, log in to websites, click
